source_findings.details: Studio task invokes load; beginLibraryOperation reserves state on MainActor then awaits the ProjectStore actor. ProjectStore initialization captures configuration; file access/fixtures run on that actor. Adoption marks loaded and clears block/conflict. Export enabled state is !(!loaded || saveBlocked || libraryOperation.isBusy). No failure-time state snapshot identifies which condition or AX operation blocked the first test.

Job uname and build targets are x86_64. The simulator/x86_64 compilation branch selects SpatialPreview before RealityStudioSurface coordinator construction. Consequently a RealityStudioSurface/StudioOrbitARView lifecycle explanation does not fit this executed path. SpatialPreview is SceneKit, with explicit gesture cleanup, stopInertia, isPlaying=false and scene=nil on detach; there is no log proving detach occurred during the AR presentation.

Menu captures SceneContext and sets showARPlacement. A generation-owner-bound sheet presents ARPlacementView. Status is unconditional; camera preview is conditional on cameraEnabled. Simulator isSupported returns false, controller initialization selects unsupported for valid layout, cameraEnabled starts false, and appeared only records visibility/foreground. This entry path does not start a camera session or construct PlacementCameraView.

Page count/share controls require a prepared result. Close is an unconditional toolbar action. Current failure follows successful prepared-result checks; neither incorrect PDF bytes nor an omitted close action is demonstrated. PDFKit drawing/AX responsiveness and sheet presentation are hypotheses without a stack or failed-state snapshot.

The ten application/core bootstrap, preview, AR, export and layout blobs listed with unchanged_vs_original=true exactly match the original 7b91c1a tree. Changed test synchronization/capture code does not establish a changed product defect.
